segment.source: Renders a band intro over a grid of two to four columns, each cell an icon, a short title and one or two sentences. Use it for: the capability overview under a hero, service listings, module and add-on summaries, 'what you get' sections, association benefit overviews. Prefer 'Benefit List' when the entries need more prose than a grid cell allows, and 'Bento Grid' when one entry should be visibly larger than the rest.
